alarms.action: Sets M191 overload alarm, raises M199 stop condition to shut down conveyor Y10
alarms.condition: Motor overload MOL-1001 contact open/lost (LDI X13)
alarms.name: Motor Overload

alarms.action: Stops conveyor motor Y10 and raises jam alarm M190 until reset (X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Pallet Jam

conflicts.narrative_says: If entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs, conveyor stops and jam alarm is raised until reset
conflicts.program_says: R2 resets M190 and R3 reads M190, but there are no rungs implementing T10 timing or detecting PE-1002 blockage to SET M190

conflicts.narrative_says: A motor overload or the E-stop chain stops the conveyor immediately (stopping conveyor when X0 is lost)
conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: Not specified directly (X0 is defined as ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy)
conflicts.program_says: R3 evaluates ORI X0 into M199, causing M199 to be ON (conveyor stopped) when E-stop is healthy (X0=1), and allowing M199 to clear when E-stop is dropped (X0=0)

interlocks.cause: Motor overload MOL-1001 (X13 lost) or E-stop chain (X0 lost)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via ST10 stop condition (M199)

interlocks.cause: Auto mode SS-0003 (X2) OFF or ST10 common fault (M199) ON

steps.entry: Auto mode SS-0003 (X2) active, no ST10 fault (M199 inactive), and E-stop healthy (X0)
steps.exit: Auto mode lost, ST10 fault/overload occurs, or E-stop lost
steps.name: Running Conveyor

steps.entry: Release request RQ-1005 (X14) rising edge sets stopper solenoid XY-1004 (Y11)
steps.exit: Release timer T11 reaches 2.0 s preset (resets Y11)
steps.name: Pallet Release
